evidence.note: The official A2A site publishes a root llms.txt index covering the current specification, concepts, SDKs and tutorials.
Canonical HTML remains an accepted fallback for reading the public documentation.
The current A2A specification distinguishes Agent Cards used by actual A2A servers from documentation about the protocol.
